profile.name: Yousef Hamed
profile.role: Front-end engineer & communications and computers engineering student
profile.intro: I design apps in Figma and build them with React, Next.js and React Native. I've also run a training centre's daily operations, so I know how to keep a project moving.

signals.label: Engineer
signals.body: Front-end work in React, Next.js and React Native, with typed APIs, auth that keeps tokens out of the browser, and full Arabic and RTL support. My AI training at Zewail City covered machine learning end to end, from notebook to deployed model.

signals.label: Manager
signals.body: Two years running Total Center's day-to-day: class schedules, logistics, instructor communication and revenue-share calculations. After that I oversaw operations at On Air Marketing Agency.

signals.label: Designer
signals.body: Two months of UI/UX work in Figma, taking apps from sitemap and style guide to finished screens, on top of a 50-hour graphic design diploma. I also design logos and presentations.

featured.title: Student App
featured.summary: A university learning platform built as three clients on one NestJS API: a student mobile app, a student web app and a staff dashboard.

parts.name: Student Center app on Google Play
parts.body: Light and dark themes, full English and Arabic with real RTL, HLS video through short-lived playback tickets, and a custom native module that blocks screen capture on Android and iOS.

parts.name: Student web app
parts.body: The mobile experience in the browser on the same backend. A server-side proxy keeps tokens in HTTP-only cookies, refreshes sessions on 401, and avoids CORS altogether.

parts.name: Admin & teacher dashboard
parts.body: Courses, students, teachers, access codes, support, notifications and logs for staff. Students are refused at sign-in, and every permission is re-checked by the API.

projects.title: Cartify
projects.body: A full-stack store with a smart return locker. A return request gets a daily 4-digit code, and the Arduino locker works out the same code offline with SHA-256, so it needs no internet. Guest carts merge into the account at sign-in, and an Expo app runs on the same API.

projects.title: Ghar Sheet
projects.body: Estimates the price of a flat anywhere in 50+ Indian cities. I cleaned a messy 187K-row Kaggle dataset, trained a scikit-learn model on it, served it with FastAPI, and built the React form that asks for the listing's details.

projects.title: Ahmed Mokhtar
projects.kind: Designer portfolio with a content dashboard
projects.body: A portfolio for Ahmed Mokhtar, a graphic and UI/UX designer. He signs in to a private dashboard to add projects, upload images and edit every word on the site, with drafts, previews and publishing. Payload CMS runs inside the same Next.js app, on PostgreSQL, with images in S3-compatible storage.

projects.title: React e-commerce store
projects.body: A multi-page shopping front end in React, built as the capstone of my front-end training and deployed on Vercel.

smallProjects.title: React Cart
smallProjects.note: Shopping cart in React, live on Vercel

designProjects.title: Shifaa
designProjects.kind: Health app, designed right to left in Arabic
designProjects.body: Patients find and filter doctors, book an appointment, upload a prescription for the pharmacy, pay, and track the delivery. 22 finished screens, built on a sitemap, a style guide and a component library.

designProjects.title: TastyGo
designProjects.body: Browse restaurants by category, open a menu, choose a dish's size and extras, check out in three steps, then follow the rider on a live map.

timeline.title: Programming instructor
timeline.body: Teach programming to children aged 4 to 17: Python, web development, UI/UX, WeDo 2.0, LEGO SPIKE, Canva, Scratch and PictoBlox.

timeline.title: Manager
timeline.body: Oversaw agency operations and coordinated day-to-day management.

timeline.title: AI and Machine Learning Foundations
timeline.body: A 90-hour programme: Python and NumPy, probability and statistics, linear algebra and optimisation, data preparation, machine learning, and neural networks. My final project was Ghar Sheet.

timeline.title: Front-end development training
timeline.body: HTML, CSS and JavaScript through to React, with a project at every stage and a React e-commerce store as the final project.

timeline.title: HR & center manager
timeline.body: Ran daily operations, schedules and logistics, spoke for the center to instructors, and calculated instructor commission and revenue share.

timeline.title: AI trainee
timeline.body: Python, machine learning, deep learning and reinforcement learning, plus time series, clustering, big data and AI ethics.

timeline.title: Data entry specialist
timeline.body: Kept student records, codes and sheets accurate and easy to find.
